    getScale

    • getScale(zoom: number): number

      Inverse of getZoom: the scale factor (|mx|) for a given zoom. Only meaningful for Web Mercator — returns NaN otherwise so callers can detect "zoom not applicable for this CRS" and fall back to scale.

      Parameters

      • zoom: number

      Returns number

      • Defined in src/geo/projection.ts:60

    getZoom

    • getZoom(mx: number): number

      Compute a zoom level from the scale factor. Only meaningful for Web Mercator — returns 0 for other CRS (not a sentinel; prefer the getScale round-trip to detect CRS).

      Parameters

      • mx: number

      Returns number
